styled.zh: 紫紅與青綠的玻璃細胞間，透明玻璃氣孔像呼吸般緩慢張開又收攏
styled.en: Glass stomata in magenta-and-teal cells slowly open and close

styled.zh: 紫水晶般的六角細胞上，幾枚透明玻璃氣孔微微張合
styled.en: Clear glass stomata flex gently on amethyst hexagonal cells

styled.zh: 綠色葉肉上的玻璃細胞，中央氣孔由窄縫撐成圓形開口
styled.en: On green tissue a central glass stoma widens from a slit to a round opening

styled.zh: 冷白玻璃表皮，成排傾斜的綠芯氣孔同步開闔
styled.en: Cool-white glass epidermis; rows of tilted green-lined stomata open in unison

styled.zh: 與上一段相近的冷白玻璃表皮，氣孔以更細微的幅度起伏
styled.en: Cool-white glass epidermis with subtler stomatal movement

styled.zh: 陽光穿透的綠色玻璃細胞，邊緣反光的氣孔輕輕鼓動
styled.en: Sunlit green glass cells; rim-lit stomata pulse softly

styled.zh: 模糊的綠色表皮逐漸對焦、亮起，右側氣孔一個接一個張開
styled.en: Blurry green epidermis snaps into focus as stomata on the right open one by one

styled.zh: 青藍色細胞壁發光的網格中，綠色氣孔同時由閉合到張開
styled.en: In a cyan-outlined cell grid, green stomata open together

styled.zh: 斜向排列的紫粉色細胞鏈，邊緣電光閃爍，中央氣孔漸亮張開
styled.en: A diagonal chain of pink-violet cells flickers; the central stoma brightens and opens

styled.zh: 暗紫背景上的螢光綠保衛細胞，帶數位雜訊般微幅抖動
styled.en: Neon-green guard cells on dark violet, jittering like digital noise

styled.zh: 紫綠錯位的色塊中，青綠氣孔隨訊號干擾變形、張合
styled.en: Teal stomata warp and pulse amid violet colour-shifted blocks

styled.zh: 深紫細胞間的螢光綠保衛細胞發亮，氣孔由細縫張成橢圓
styled.en: Bioluminescent green guard cells glow on deep violet; slits swell into ovals

styled.zh: 藍紫細胞網格中，螢光綠氣孔緩慢張開，像在吸氣
styled.en: In a blue-violet grid, glowing stomata open slowly like an inhale

styled.zh: 同一片螢光表皮，氣孔開得更大、更圓
styled.en: The same glowing epidermis; stomata open wider and rounder

styled.zh: 紫色葉肉上一簇螢光氣孔，綠光由內向外擴散、細縫漸開
styled.en: A cluster of glowing stomata on violet tissue; light spreads as slits open

styled.zh: 螢光逐漸漲滿整個畫面，氣孔群一起亮起
styled.en: Fluorescence floods the frame as the stomatal cluster lights up

styled.zh: 整片表皮轉為亮綠，深色的氣孔開口清楚張開
styled.en: The epidermis turns bright green; dark stomatal pores open clearly

styled.zh: 紫綠螢光下的氣孔群，只有微弱的明暗呼吸
styled.en: Violet-green glowing stomata with only a faint breathing pulse

styled.zh: 螢光氣孔群的細縫一起由閉到開，葉綠體亮點閃爍
styled.en: Glowing stomata open together; chloroplast specks sparkle

styled.zh: 液態水銀鑄成的細胞壁，鏡面氣孔由細縫鼓成深色圓孔
styled.en: Liquid-mercury cell walls; mirrored stomata swell from slits into dark pores

styled.zh: 同一片水銀表皮，氣孔開得更圓，綠色葉肉從縫隙透出
styled.en: The same mercury surface; pores open rounder, green tissue shows through

styled.zh: 流動的銀色細胞平台浮在綠葉上，邊緣氣孔反光開闔
styled.en: A flowing silver cell plate over green leaf; rim stomata glint as they open

styled.zh: 銀亮的金屬細胞包圍綠色葉肉，氣孔環緩慢旋開
styled.en: Chrome cells surround green tissue; ring-shaped stomata slowly unfurl

styled.zh: 金屬表皮上的氣孔環逐一鼓起、張開，像金屬在呼吸
styled.en: Stomatal rings on the metal skin bulge and open, as if metal breathed

styled.zh: 水銀表皮的氣孔張開後透出黃綠色的內裡
styled.en: Mercury stomata open to reveal yellow-green interiors

styled.zh: 鏡面細胞中央亮起一片綠葉，周圍的翠綠氣孔同時張開
styled.en: A green leaf patch lights up amid chrome cells as emerald stomata open

styled.zh: 紫色葉肉上的鉻銀細胞，內嵌翠綠氣孔微微開合
styled.en: Chrome cells over violet tissue, emerald stomata gently pulsing

styled.zh: 深藍底上的青色線稿：多邊形細胞網與發光的氣孔輪廓，細縫隨節奏開合
styled.en: Cyan line drawing on navy: a polygon cell grid with glowing stomata opening in rhythm

uncanny.zh: 玻璃氣孔張開後，中央浮現一顆顆像眼珠的圓點
uncanny.en: Glass stomata open to reveal eyeball-like irises

uncanny.zh: 同一片玻璃表皮，綠光滲入後氣孔全部變成凝視的眼睛
uncanny.en: Green light seeps in and every glass stoma becomes a staring eye

uncanny.zh: 藍圖線稿的保衛細胞膨脹變形，邊緣長出泡狀突起
uncanny.en: Blueprint guard cells swell and sprout bubbly growths

uncanny.zh: 青色網格中的綠色氣孔張成一張張張開的嘴
uncanny.en: Green stomata in a cyan grid stretch into gaping mouths

uncanny.zh: 螢光綠保衛細胞變成張大的嘴，嘴裡長出細小的牙齒
uncanny.en: Neon guard cells turn into wide mouths lined with tiny teeth

uncanny.zh: 螢光綠保衛細胞浮現模糊的臉部五官，隨後又收回
uncanny.en: Faint facial features surface on neon guard cells, then recede

uncanny.zh: 螢光綠保衛細胞變成一張張尖叫般的人臉
uncanny.en: Neon guard cells morph into screaming faces

uncanny.zh: 紫色組織上的綠色氣孔睜開，變成轉動的大眼睛
uncanny.en: Green stomata on violet tissue open into rolling eyes

uncanny.zh: 螢光綠保衛細胞膨脹成巨大的人臉，嘴巴越張越大
uncanny.en: Neon guard cells inflate into huge faces with ever-wider mouths

uncanny.zh: 一群螢光人臉從氣孔中浮出，表情驚愕
uncanny.en: A crowd of startled glowing faces rises out of the stomata

uncanny.zh: 螢光綠的氣孔臉孔緩慢張嘴，綠光向外暈開
uncanny.en: Glowing stoma-faces slowly open their mouths as green light bleeds out

uncanny.zh: 兩張相連的氣孔臉孔被拉長變形
uncanny.en: Two joined stoma-faces stretch and distort

uncanny.zh: 塑膠質感的綠色細胞長出小眼睛與嘴，像卡通生物
uncanny.en: Plastic-looking green cells sprout tiny eyes and mouths like cartoon creatures

uncanny.zh: 綠色氣孔一個個睜開，變成同心圓的大眼睛
uncanny.en: Green stomata open one by one into concentric staring eyes

uncanny.zh: 整片表皮的細胞都張開嘴，露出粉紅色的舌頭
uncanny.en: Every cell on the surface opens a mouth, showing pink tongues

uncanny.zh: 綠色氣孔變成露齒吐舌的嘴唇
uncanny.en: Green stomata turn into lips baring teeth and tongues

uncanny.zh: 塑膠綠的氣孔環張開，裡面是一顆顆綠色眼球
uncanny.en: Plastic-green stomatal rings open onto green eyeballs

uncanny.zh: 水銀表皮的氣孔睜開，露出寫實的灰綠色眼睛
uncanny.en: Mercury stomata open to reveal realistic grey-green eyes

uncanny.zh: 銀色細胞平台上的氣孔全變成眼睛，越睜越大
uncanny.en: Every stoma on the silver plate becomes an eye, opening wider and wider

uncanny.zh: 鉻銀細胞間滿是翠綠虹膜的眼睛，中央一顆巨眼緩緩睜開
uncanny.en: Emerald-iris eyes fill the chrome cells; a giant eye opens at the centre

strips.zh: 紫錦草 500× 藍光：同一個氣孔在 40 分鐘內由閉合到張開
strips.en: One stoma opening over 40 min (T. pallida, 500x, blue light)
strips.notes: 試算表對這段錄影的紀錄（所標註的氣孔不一定是圖中這一顆）：約 17 分鐘前接近 0%，19:30 約 30%，25:25 約 55%，之後回落；36 分鐘起照明色調改變（畫面轉綠）。以模板比對自動追蹤同一個氣孔後裁切；sprite 由左到右依時間排列。

strips.zh: 紫錦草 500× 藍光：同一片葉的另一個氣孔
strips.en: A second stoma on the same leaf (T. pallida, 500x, blue light)
strips.notes: 與 micro-strip-01 同一段錄影、同一組時間點。以模板比對自動追蹤同一個氣孔後裁切；sprite 由左到右依時間排列。

strips.zh: 紫錦草 500× 藍光：60 分鐘長錄影中的緩慢張開
strips.en: Slow opening in a 60-min recording (T. pallida, 500x, blue light)
strips.notes: 試算表對這段錄影的紀錄（所標註的氣孔不一定是圖中這一顆）：0–13 分鐘約 0%，24–38 分鐘 20–40%，38–46 分鐘 40–100%（效果顯著）；約 8 分鐘處照明改變，畫面由黃轉綠。以模板比對自動追蹤同一個氣孔後裁切；sprite 由左到右依時間排列。

strips.zh: 紫錦草 約 700× 手持顯微鏡：晚開但顯著
strips.en: Late but clear opening (T. pallida, ~700x handheld microscope)
strips.notes: 試算表對這段錄影的紀錄：開關較緩慢但效果顯著，47–61 分鐘約 60%；手持顯微鏡畫面偏柔。以模板比對自動追蹤同一個氣孔後裁切；sprite 由左到右依時間排列。
